To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Spcdc25 expression in DN tobacco induces early flowering and that the early competence of SAMs in Spcdc25 plants to respond to florigenic signals is responsible for precocious flowering.
(1) Spcdc25 tobacco flowers earlier with fewer leaves than WT, (2) Spcdc25 SAM is competent to flower earlier than WT and, (3) Spcdc25 flowers from axillary meristems.
the expression of Spcdc25 in tobacco causes precocious flowering.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether DN plants flower because they are able to export sufficient amount of floral stimulus or the SAM has to be developmentally competent to interpret the arrival of the signal.
how the SAM acquires competence to become reproductive and the results indicate that the SAM becomes floral competent earlier in Spcdc25 than WT plants.
how the SAM becomes competent to interpret the arrival of the florigenic signal.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

DN tobacco is a day neutral plant and that flowering in this plant is a consequence of the export of a florigenic signal by the vegetative SAM and its response in a SAM that has acquired competence to flower.

DN plants are not true DN but are actually long day plants (LDP) and the florigenic signal is exported even in vegetative plants but the SAM has a developmental programme that is not responsive to it until it reaches a certain developmental stage.
DN tobacco flowers when the SAM becomes competent to respond to a floral stimulus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Spcdc25 is a mitotic activator that induces precocious floral competence in the SAM.
the SAM of Spcdc25 tobacco plants is competent to flower earlier than WT and responds to the floral stimulus produced in vegetative WT plants.
DN plants flower because of the SAM competence to respond to a florigenic signal.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SAM is a major site for the integration of environmental and endogenous signals to control flowering time.
the SAM can be sensitised to become floral in true DN plants.
the DN tobacco SAMs become floral competent earlier than WT.
